company.name: Vayyar
company.shortDescription: Vayyar is a semiconductor company that produces 4D imaging radar sensors for automotive, medical, and retail industries.
company.description:
Vayyar manufactures 4D imaging radar that provides solutions for senior care, automotive, security, smart home, robotics, and more. It aims to deliver the next generation of sensing technology that is miniature, affordable, and versatile enough to impact everyone's lives, enabling a safer world.

The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Yehud-Monosson, Israel.

aiResearchSummary.text: Vayyar is engaged in developing radar-based systems for applications such as monitoring activity in parked vehicles, gesture recognition, telemedical health monitoring, vehicle cabin occupancy detection, and retail shelf monitoring. Their work includes systems for imaging concealed surfaces, scanning for concealed objects, shaping beams produced by antenna arrays, and providing wide beam radar arrays. These efforts span automotive, medical, and retail sectors, highlighting advancements in 4D imaging radar sensor technology.
